triage.verifier_justification: I tried to refute this as mechanical or as an enhancement and could not: the pre-fix file at 91d3b50b9c has nine `effective_from: '2025-08-07'` versions and zero `effective_to` lines, and the fix adds `effective_to: '2026-02-14'` to every one of the nine, which changes what each rule yields for any day after that bound — a version-window change, not metadata. The pinned corpus text for us/statute/hts/9903.02.58 (release us-rulespec-2026-08-03-ecps-pit-tariff-union, body sha 9515165c1e) ends with the verbatim "[Compiler's note: provision terminated. See 90 Fed. Reg. 59281.]", so the open-ended pre-fix encoding kept a source-terminated +39% Switzerland heading live forever — the "timeless encoding of superseded text" case the kind definition names, and the pre-fix summary already recited the termination it failed to encode. The reader's boundary reading also checks out: reciprocal-switzerland-9903-02-83.yaml at this same commit runs from `effective_from: '2026-02-15'`, so 2026-02-14 is the day before the successor floor heading with no gap or overlap. No better kind fits: nothing was removed or re-grounded, no comparison strictness changed, and the only changed rule paths are versions[0].effective_to plus its proof atoms.
triage.verifier_notes: Strongest surviving objection, which I judge non-fatal: the specific date 2026-02-14 is not in the cited source. The provision text carries no termination date, and the nine new proof atoms excerpt only the compiler's note ("[Compiler's note: provision terminated. See 90 Fed. Reg. 59281.]"), not any date; the module comment itself concedes the bound is inferred from the successors' 2026-02-15 panel domain rather than read from the text. So the exact terminal date is an editorial inference, and a reviewer who wants every value source-traceable could call the date under-evidenced. That does not rescue the pre-fix state, though: the defect being corrected is the unbounded window on a provision the source marks terminated, which is wrong against the source independent of which precise day the bound lands on. Secondary consideration for the reviewer: one could argue unrepresented_clause (the compiler's note is a source clause the encoding omitted), but the kind list routes effective_to/version-window omissions and timeless encoding of superseded text to wrong_period_or_effective_date, and the changed rule path is literally versions[0].effective_to, so I did not reclassify. Side observation, out of scope for this case: the sibling reciprocal-switzerland-9903-02-82.yaml (the >=15% pass-through heading) runs from 2025-08-07 rather than 2026-02-15 at this commit, unlike its .83 floor partner — worth a separate look if the corpus puts both successors in the same 2026-02-15 domain.
